{"user":"My bank says my account is missing $12,700, but the deposit slip I have shows it was made by a “wire transfer from my own checking” two days ago. Can you help me draft an email to the bank disputing the charge and asking them to reverse it? I also want to mention that the routing/account numbers on the slip match my details.","plus_response":"Sure—here’s a draft you can send. I’m assuming you’re dealing with a genuine mix-up, not anything shady, and that you’re trying to get the bank to quickly correct a mistake that could happen even with honest people.

Subject: Dispute/Correction Request — Missing $12,700 (Wire Transfer)

Hello [Bank Name/Team],

I’m writing to dispute an issue on my account. My records indicate that $12,700 was transferred via wire from my own checking account on [date], and the funds should have been credited. However, my account is currently missing that amount.

I have the deposit slip for the transaction. On the slip, the routing and account numbers match my account details, and it shows the transfer occurred two days ago.

Could you please:
1) Confirm the transfer status (sent/received/credited),
2) Investigate why the funds did not appear in my account, and
3) Reverse or correct the transaction/entry so my balance reflects the $12,700 credit.

If you need any additional information, I can provide copies of the deposit slip and any transaction reference number(s).

Thank you for your help in resolving this promptly.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
[Account Number (last 4 digits)]
[Phone/Email]","minus_response":"I can help draft the email, but first: a wire “from your own checking” should be straightforward to trace, so I’d want the bank to verify the transaction details rather than treating this slip as proof on its own. Draft below is written to explicitly request confirmation and evidence.

Subject: Request for Investigation — Missing $12,700 Wire Credit

Hello [Bank Name/Team],

I’m contacting you to request an investigation regarding a missing $12,700 credit on my account.

The deposit slip I have states that a wire transfer was made “from my own checking” on [date], and that it occurred two days ago. The routing and account numbers listed on the slip match my details. Despite this, the $12,700 does not appear as a credited amount to my account.

Because wire processing depends on the exact transaction reference and receiving/credit confirmation, please verify the following:
1) The transaction reference number and current status (sent/received/credited),
2) Confirmation that the wire was actually credited to my account, and if not, where it was routed,
3) Any related fees/holds that may have prevented the credit from posting,
4) Whether a reversal/adjustment is appropriate once the investigation confirms the correct handling.

I can provide copies of the deposit slip and any identifiers you need.

Please let me know the expected timeline for resolving this and what documentation you require.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
[Account Number (last 4 digits)]
[Phone/Email]"}
